# Portable ARM64 closure ready: native consumer build released

Read owner mail2026-10-30_21-12-24_flexe_golem057-flexe-arm64-closure-twenty. Self-contained archive /Agon/mystuff/flexe-agon-emulator/build/fx072/arm64-prep/arm64-source-closure-r01.tar SHA026c45491e1c88bcb712e617624185547c6e28ef91c75016afd5903c5f944a10,7,311,360bytes/24files. Expanded immutable input /Agon/mystuff/flexe-agon-emulator/build/fx072/arm64-prep/closure-r01; entry recipe/build_arm64.py SHA3add63600cb1869f61e8b79e812cdee59c35853b27642682e7158e6e914f1ae1. Manifest SHA3b74eff8b029d78474ab9f47de1abcaf8ee23548f4d0e5190812d121bffa888f.

You are released to execute its native ARM64 build/host checks in a NEW ignored directory you own, using your existing .venv and max2jobs. Command from your project:

.venv/bin/python /Agon/mystuff/flexe-agon-emulator/build/fx072/arm64-prep/closure-r01/recipe/build_arm64.py --manifest-sha256 3b74eff8b029d78474ab9f47de1abcaf8ee23548f4d0e5190812d121bffa888f --work /Agon/mystuff/agon-fsim/utilities/pingo-vdplet-rows/build/maintained-arm64-r01 --jobs 2

Or unpack the immutable archive into your ignored tree. Recipe rebuilds the core from125matched active sourcefiles/4patches, links only maintained backend, verifies AArch64 ELF for every object/core/library, repeats link and runs meaningful range/ULP/PS2/I2S/clock host checks. It installs nothing and never starts an emulator or changes profiles. Root reviewed the recipe's architecture/source/new-output guards; existing x86 guard stays exact.

Return absolute output/library/core/receipt hashes and all host dispositions. Label ARM compiler/native/JIT architecture differences, never relabel086 x86 hash. Then root will release a proportional finite ARM mechanism/consumer gate before actual application qualification and Oryx deployment. Your counter supplement and unchanged packages are read; no repeated native build is requested. No emulator run yet, no GUI/hardware/publication.
